scenes.title: Act 1 — Editorial Opener
scenes.speaker: Sarah
scenes.text: [warmly] Three hundred kilometers an hour — and a full cup of green tea barely ripples.

scenes.title: Act 2 — Rail Evolution Panorama
scenes.speaker: Sarah
scenes.text: [curious] From roaring steam engines to a nose shaped like a diving kingfisher, rail travel learned to glide in silence.

scenes.title: Act 3 — Sculpted Anatomy
scenes.speaker: Sarah
scenes.text: [thoughtful] A sculpted nose silences tunnels, continuous rails erase the clatter, and active dampers cushion every bend.

scenes.title: Act 4 — Six Decades of Speed
scenes.speaker: Sarah
scenes.text: [excited] Watch six decades of rail speed overtake each other — from classic steam all the way to three hundred fifty kilometers an hour.

scenes.title: Act 5 — Four Quiet Secrets
scenes.speaker: Sarah
scenes.text: [warmly] Four quiet engineering choices turn blistering speed into the calmest seat on earth.
